name: Copy to Clipboard
description: Sitewide copy-to-clipboard button for any element marked with the class cp-to-clip.
project_description:
The Copy to Clipboard module is a tiny module that allows a copy to clipboard capability by simply adding a class "cp-to-clip" to any block or inline HTML element, e.g.
Text ....
. The module attaches a plain JavaScript file with no dependencies and a CSS file to every page, which add a "copy" button to the end of the text; clicking the button, or the text, copies the text to the clipboard. There is no configuration page and none is required. To apply the class from a WYSIWYG, add the styles dropdown to a text format's toolbar and register entries such as p.cp-to-clip, span.cp-to-clip and div.cp-to-clip. Similar projects: Clipboard.js is a more advanced module built on the clipboard.js jQuery library; cp2clip is a purely JavaScript function independent of jQuery, with no configuration.
